correctness.rationale: The supplied facets reconstruct f=(14,84,140,70). Contracting a deterministic spanning tree identifies the integral cycle lattice with Z^71. An exact 71-by-71 triangular-boundary minor has determinant 4, so the full boundary lattice has index at most 4. A lifted mod-four cocycle annihilates all 140 triangular boundaries and has odd image, giving a surjection of H1 onto Z/4; hence H1 is exactly Z/4. Exhausting all 3-cliques gives 140 face triangles plus 143 empty triangles, all 143 empty boundaries nonzero, with 105 order-four and 38 order-two classes. Risk: the argument is exact for the supplied finite complex and does not address other triangulations.

value.rationale: The shortest simple integral-homology cycles form a natural combinatorial systolic invariant. The complete classification is structurally informative because the minimizers realize both possible nonzero order strata of H1=Z/4: 105 primitive order-four classes and 38 order-two classes. This goes beyond recomputing a known face vector or homology group. Risk: the value is exact-object/local rather than a family theorem, and no claim of broader universality is made.
